Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/confirmation-visible/ledger/solution.py`.

It selects the latest event per key by highest revision, breaking ties by last payload order, treats winning deletes as tombstones, optionally includes deleted entries based on `config["include_deleted"]`, and returns `live` and `deleted` sorted by key.
